title: shared intrinsic Mirror with sparse private residual coordinates
status: FAIL (25% private-fraction development byte gate missed)
hypothesis: A per-task Mirror angle plus validation-selected sparse residual coordinates will preserve quality and use at least 10% fewer actual bytes than adaptive direct coordinates at private task fractions 0% and 25%; the frontier will converge toward global intrinsic coordinates at higher fractions.
physical_object: shared 32D linear predictor plus a paid random orthonormal 32x8 task-update basis
mirror_coordinate: one task-specific FP16 angle over the first two shared basis columns, followed by ordinary FP16 residual coordinates over selected remaining basis columns
logical_multiplicity: 256 task-conditioned predictors with controlled private-task fraction; task count is not independent capacity
controls: adaptive direct FP16 coefficients on same basis and residual-rank choices

data.private_residual: private tasks receive iid Gaussian coordinates with std 0.12 in shared basis columns 3-8; task labels are not provided to the representation selector
data.rank_selection: fit on support; choose smallest residual rank k in [0,2,4,6] or direct prefix d in [2,4,6,8] with validation normalized MSE <= 1e-4; test is held out

selection.tunable: none; task fractions, seeds, dimensions, precisions, threshold, solvers and controls are frozen

protocol_amendment_before_fresh.mirror_solver: for each candidate residual rank, variable-project the common plane and support targets orthogonally to the candidate residual subspace, then select the minimum-support-error angle on the fixed 720-point grid and refit residual coefficients
protocol_amendment_before_fresh.packed_code_layout: concatenate each task's angle then residual coefficients; task offsets are deterministically derived from stored active-rank tags and are not separately serialized
protocol_amendment_before_fresh.reason: the initial development-only coordinate-descent implementation missed validation quality on some private tasks, and serialized redundant offsets obscured the actual code payload; no fresh data had been accessed
protocol_amendment_before_fresh.fresh_reselection: rerun all frozen development seeds under the amended deterministic solver/layout; fresh still opens only if low-private gates pass

storage.authority: actual serialized inference payload bytes after reload
storage.format: fixed timestamp ZIP with uncompressed NPY arrays

success_gate: At fractions 0% and 25% on both development seeds, Mirror mean test normalized MSE <=1e-4, within 1e-5 of adaptive direct, and total actual serialized payload <=90% of adaptive direct.
failure_gate: Either low-private development fraction misses the byte or quality margin. Higher-private cases remain frontier observations even if they fail.

fresh.open_condition: only after both 0% and 25% development worlds pass all success gates

boundaries: fixed-radius aligned common orbit known by construction
iid residuals restricted to the paid shared basis
